The affix अण् comes in the 4-fold sense after a stem having क् for its penultimate.

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

After a word having क् as its penultimate, the affix अण् comes in the sense of modification or a part or both, as appropriate.

Terms: अण्

The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after a word denoting a place and having the letter क as its penultimate.

Terms: अण्
